title: Even So: con todo, aun así
goal: Say that something stays true in spite of everything just said with con todo and aun así.

items: I can use *aun así* to say that something happens in spite of a difficulty.
I can use *con todo* in the same way in a more formal style.
I can tell *aun así* and *con todo* from *aunque*.
